title: Line Beginning/End (0, $)
instruction_text:
Jump to line boundaries instantly!

'0' = jump to start of line
'$' = jump to end of line

Your task: Add 'START ' at beginning and ' END' at end

Steps for first line:
1. Press '0' to jump to start
2. Press 'i' to insert
3. Type 'START '
4. Press ESC
5. Press '$' to jump to end
6. Press 'a' to append
7. Type ' END'
8. Press ESC
9. Repeat for second line (press 'j' then '0')
10. Save and quit with :wq
target_content:
START middle text END
START another line END
